thread:
nina_cs: Hey team — kicking off Lumenica Therapeutics onboarding. Looking to align owners, must-haves, and a 5-week ramp. Proposed kickoff: Wed 11am PT. Can people confirm availability?

lumenica_pm: Hi Nina, Wed 11 works for us. I'll be the customer PM (Aisha). Quick priorities: secure PHI pipeline, single-sign-on via Okta, and cost estimate for steady-state 100 req/s.

ryan_se: I'll take lead on integration + perf testing. Need sample payloads and expected token sizes. Also: are they planning to use Hosted or Dedicated?

lumenica_pm: Start on Hosted for baseline, plan to evaluate Dedicated if latency/cost need it. Payloads avg ~1.4k tokens, batch sizes small but bursts at 9-11am PT.

ops_jen: From infra: for Hosted baseline we need signed DPA before any PHI goes through. If they move to Dedicated, we'll need VPC peering and a 2-week lead for capacity. Also note certificate rotation planned in Week 2.

oliver_prod: I'll join kickoff to map rollout dependencies. Success criteria from product side: p95 latency <500ms on production-like load, zero PHI leakage in logs, and enablement completion for 4 engineers.

emma_enablement: I'll schedule 2 sessions: Console & Ops (30m) and Troubleshooting (30m). Can someone give me emails for invites? I'll record both.

nina_cs: Draft timeline: Week 0 - kickoff + intake; Week 1 - DPA, allowlist, payload ingest; Week 2 - hosted baseline perf; Week 3 - security review & cert rotation; Week 4 - enablement + cutover rehearsal; Week 5 - go-live & retro. Any blockers?

lumenica_pm: DPA held up by legal, but our GC is looped in. Renewal/Risk note: execs need PHI-safe signoff by Week 3 or they'll pause budget.

ryan_se: Action items I'll need from Lumenica: allowlist IPs, sample payloads, schema, Okta metadata if SSO. I'll drop a small script to compute token distribution.

ops_jen: Billing-bot will run a cost estimate during Week 1 based on sample volume; tag @billing-bot once payloads are uploaded.

billing-bot: Auto: Cost estimator scheduled. Please upload sample payloads to https://storage.redwood/onboard-lumenica by 2025-05-02.

nina_cs: Adding owners to board now: @lumenica_pm (customer PM), @ryan_se (SE), @ops_jen (Infra), @emma_enablement (Enablement), @oliver_prod (Product), @nina_cs (CS). Please react when tasks done.

oliver_prod: I'll coordinate Dedicated eval if baseline misses latency target. Also flaging Week 2 for a short billing/commit discussion.

emma_enablement: Noted — will draft quickstart and agenda. Need list of seats for training (who from Lumenica?).

lumenica_pm: We'll send attendee names and Okta SAML metadata by Friday.

nina_cs: Perfect. Kickoff invite sent for Wed 2025-04-23 11:00 PT. Thanks everyone — keeping PHI gating top priority. :white_check_mark:
